title: Receive worth from the Truth that dyes the heart
summary: The shabad does not give the ego another mirror. Those who meditate on the True One are dyed in Truth, so dignity is received by absorption in what is real, not borrowed from applause.
takeaway: Let Truth give the heart a worth no audience can loan or remove.
lifeApplication: When worth feels outsourced, sit with what remains true without praise. Let that truth steady your next answer before you ask the room to confirm you.

source.shortMeaning: Meditating on the True One dyes the heart in Truth and receives worth from what is most real.
source.lifeApplication: When worth feels borrowed, return to Truth before defending yourself to an audience.

evidence.coreClaim: The cited lines locate worth in absorption into Truth rather than in the reflection returned by others.
evidence.turn: The heart moves from borrowed validation to the dignity of being dyed in what is real.
evidence.practicalImplication: When worth feels outsourced, sit with what remains true without praise. Let that truth steady your next answer before you ask the room to confirm you.
